# Fate UI v0.9.5-beta1

A feature prerelease: model visibility controls, a smarter voice gate, compact layout polish, and a full dependency refresh.

## Added

- **Per-model visibility.** Every provider now has a models dialog in Settings where individual models can be hidden. Hidden models disappear from the model picker, the command palette, and the subagent catalog, and a disabled model can no longer be the default. Subagent spawning and team coordinators respect the same list, so hidden models fail fast with a clear message instead of erroring deep inside a run.
- **Compaction section in Settings.** Message density controls moved to their own place, so tuning how dense the transcript renders no longer lives under appearance.
- **Performance CI.** The renderer now gets profiled in CI so search and rendering regressions are caught before a release.

## Changed

- **Smarter local dictation.** The silence gate now works on 30 ms frames with a pre-roll buffer and a hangover tail, ported from Handy's SmoothedVad design. Word onsets are no longer clipped, thinking pauses do not feed the decoder, and Windows, macOS, and Linux share one PCM path with no extra native dependency.
- **Compact mode polish.** Header and browser-pane actions now clear the fixed window-controls strip on Windows and Linux when the inspector is collapsed, and the draggable header regions were split so dragging works without fighting the buttons.
- **Sessions survive a crash.** The active session is kept after a renderer crash instead of being dropped on restart.

## Dependencies

- **yt-dlp 2026.08.19** (from 2026.07.04): YouTube, TikTok, Apple, and Instagram extractor fixes, plus a refreshed third-party license bundle. All pins re-verified against the signed release checksums.
- **lucide-react 1.x** (from 0.468): the GitHub brand icon was removed upstream, so the commit card now carries the official GitHub mark inline.
- **transcribe-cpp 0.2.1** (from 0.1.3): diarization support, a `rocm` backend, and opaque device handles. Fate UI never used the removed `gpuDevice` API, so no migration was needed.
- **dompurify 3.4.14** (allow-list bypass fix), **mermaid 11.17**, **electron 43.4.1**, **vite 8.2.2**, **vitest 4.1.11**, **jest-dom 7**, **cross-env 10**, plus Radix UI, typebox, react-virtuoso, and testing-library patches.
- **@radix-ui/react-popover is held at 1.1.22** because 1.1.23 carries an upstream regression (radix-ui/primitives#4124) that breaks popover content. It moves once upstream fixes it.

## Verification

- Local validation: TypeScript typecheck, the full unit suite (156 files, 1475 tests), a production build, and the end-to-end Electron suite (4 specs).
- GitHub Actions runs the standard four-platform pipeline: build, install, and smoke test on Windows x64, macOS Apple Silicon, macOS Intel, and Linux x64.

## Notes

- Public beta installers are unsigned. Verify each download against the `SHA256SUMS` file shipped with the release.
